fields.name: number
fields.description: Extracts the numbers after the dash '-' in the Phone field.
fields.formula:
IF(
  FIND("-", {flddF5X0a7DtDJRNf}),
  MID(
    {flddF5X0a7DtDJRNf},
    FIND("-", {flddF5X0a7DtDJRNf}) + 1,
    LEN({flddF5X0a7DtDJRNf}) - FIND("-", {flddF5X0a7DtDJRNf})
  ),
  BLANK()
)

fields.name: Age
fields.description: Calculates the current age based on the DOB field.
fields.formula:
IF(
  {fld1Zt1g7IGjk2mOX},
  YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR({fld1Zt1g7IGjk2mOX}) - IF(
    OR(
      MONTH(TODAY()) < MONTH({fld1Zt1g7IGjk2mOX}),
      AND(MONTH(TODAY()) = MONTH({fld1Zt1g7IGjk2mOX}), DAY(TODAY()) < DAY({fld1Zt1g7IGjk2mOX}))
    ),
    1,
    0
  ),
  BLANK()
)

fields.name: Follow-up interval (for chronic monitoring) (from Chronic Diagnosis)
SHORT DESCRIPTION (VALID ICD-10 FY2026) (from Chronic Diagnosis)
Time Elapsed (Days)
fields.description: Calculates the number of days elapsed since the Last Visit Date until today.

fields.name: Chronic Recall Sent On
fields.description: Set by Make scenario 'Chronic Recall — 90 Day' when the chronic follow-up WhatsApp template has been sent. Blank = eligible. Prevents the daily scenario from re-firing on the same patient.

fields.name: Chronic Recall Condition
fields.description: The mapped condition group the chronic recall message was sent for. Written by Make at send time so the log and the patient record agree.

fields.name: Chronic Recall Groups
fields.description: Rewrite to split on the comma-separated string Airtable actually produces for this select lookup, and strip mental-health groups positionally via regex rather than SUBSTITUTE (which misses consecutive duplicates).

fields.name: Chronic Recall Primary Condition
fields.description: Split on comma to match the corrected Chronic Recall Groups format.

fields.name: Chronic Recall Eligible
fields.description: 1 = due for a chronic recall message. Requires: 90+ days since last visit (Follow-up interval on all Top 30 codes is 'Every 3 months'), a messageable chronic condition, a phone number, and not already sent. This is the single field the Make scenario filters on.

fields.name: Chronic Recall Template ID
fields.formula: SWITCH({fldB3w0oECaHSvdvO}, "Hypertension / Hypertensive disease", 13159, "Diabetes mellitus (Type 1/2/other)", 13164, "Hyperlipidemia", 13163, "Hypothyroidism", 13169, "Chronic kidney disease", 13168, "Asthma", 13162, "COPD", 13165, "Rheumatoid arthritis", 13161, "Atrial fibrillation / flutter", 13167, "Epilepsy", 13166, 13170)

fields.name: Acute Sync On
fields.description: Written by Make scenario 'Acute Follow-Up — MRD Sync' when this visit has been pushed to the Acute Clinical Follow-Up Automation base (appH2jHpsNR1nqEQ2). Blank = not yet synced. Do not edit manually.
